handoff_instructions.purpose: Handoffs document the current state and scope of the project so a new LLM session can pick up exactly where the last one left off. They are the primary continuity mechanism for this project.
what_to_include: A summary of what was done, discussed, decided, or built in this session
What worked and what did not work
Current pipeline state — what scripts exist, what their status is, what the next steps are
A condensed recap of prior sessions so the new LLM has full project context without reading every previous handoff
Open questions or blockers that carry into the next session
what_not_to_include: Exhaustive code listings — reference file paths instead
Decisions that were reversed or abandoned mid-session — only document final state
Speculation about distant future work — stay close to what is actually next
format_rules: This handoff_instructions block must appear at the top of every future handoff
When a user says 'create a handoff for this session,' use this block as the template and fill in the session-specific fields
Prior session summaries should be condensed — one paragraph per session, not a full retelling
Be brief but complete. A new LLM should be able to start working immediately after reading this file

system_prompt_utility_connections.what: Split CONNECT TO EXIST SEWER and CONNECT TO EXIST WATER rules
system_prompt_utility_connections.sewer_rule: Default 1 EA. Use 2 EA only if sewer main clearly runs full corridor to both ends. Do not use road_connection_count.
system_prompt_utility_connections.water_rule: Use min(road_connection_count, 2). Cap at 2 — a Gemini count of 3 on multi-branch layouts is an overcount artifact.
system_prompt_utility_connections.why: Test 7 had road_connection_count=3 applied to both, yielding 3 sewer connects (actual 1) and 3 water connects (actual 2). Portfolio data: sewer=1 EA in 7/9 jobs, sewer=2 EA in 2/9 (arc/full-corridor layouts only); water=2 EA in 6/10 jobs.

system_prompt_concrete_approach.what: Changed 6" Concrete Approach from unconditional include to analog-gated include
system_prompt_concrete_approach.old_rule: Include as standard line item; omit only if 2+ analogs omit AND no scope mention
system_prompt_concrete_approach.new_rule: Include only if at least 1 of the 2 closest analogs includes it, OR scope_notes explicitly mentions driveway approaches
system_prompt_concrete_approach.why: Test 7 had $16,740 false positive — Boyds Landing and Painted Rock (closest analogs) both omit it. Test 8 correctly included it because scope_notes said '24' wide driveway approaches'.

system_prompt_exc_to_embank.what: Replaced flat $20k floor with four-tier logic driven by Gemini earthwork_balance

tiers.roughly_balanced: Scale from balanced analogs (e.g. Woodman $12,500). No floor.

system_prompt_exc_to_embank.note: Import and export assumed equal cost. Test 8 showed a new risk: Gemini assessed Killdeer as roughly_balanced but the actual line item is 'INCL IMPORT' at $38k. The EXC TO EMBANK assessment from Gemini needs skeptical review.

gemini_instability_finding.observation: Gemini returned lot_count=26 on test 8 for the same PDF that returned 18 on tests 5, 6, and 7. This is non-deterministic extraction variance, not a prompt logic error.
gemini_instability_finding.impact: lot_count cascades into sewer services, water services, irrigation sleeves, and driveway approaches — the highest-value per-lot items. A 8-lot error = ~$50k error.
gemini_instability_finding.mitigation_discussed: User-verifiable input override (UI layer) is the right long-term fix. Before building that, investigate whether the lot_count prompt guidance can be tightened to reduce variance.

architecture_discussion.topic: Hooking the pipeline to a conversational UI (e.g. LibreChat)
architecture_discussion.conclusion: Fully feasible. Three paths: (1) --chat flag on CLI (~50 lines, afternoon of work), (2) save/resume session JSON for persistence, (3) MCP server for LibreChat integration. The core insight: Claude already has all context (extracted facts, knowledge pack, analogs, estimate) in the messages array — it just gets discarded after the one-shot run. Keeping it alive enables natural follow-up. Path 1 recommended as the first step.
architecture_discussion.complication: LibreChat currently talks to Ollama, not Anthropic API. Post-estimate conversation through Ollama would lose the extended thinking context. MCP path required to keep it on Claude.

key_decisions_made: Killdeer is converged at test 7 (+2.2%) — do not run more Killdeer tests unless investigating a specific regression
Gemini lot_count instability is a known risk; flag for investigation or user-override before moving on
Co-occurrence rule is comprehensive — no new pairs needed beyond the existing scan rule
EXC TO EMBANK: the tiered earthwork_balance rule is the right architecture, but Gemini's field assessment needs validation on new jobs
Do not change the Gemini model string
